title: Estágio Administrativo
description:
A Egrégora está em busca de uma nova integrante para o Setor de Processos!

Se você é proativa, organizada e analítica, essa vaga é pra você! 


Atribuições:

  • Apoio no controle e organização de documentos;
  • Acompanhamento de prazos e processos;
  • Atualização de planilhas e sistemas internos (ClickUp);
  • Suporte ao cliente.


Requisitos:

  • Estar cursando Administração, Direito, Gestão de Processos ou áreas afins (a partir do 3º semestre);
  • Conhecimento básico/intermediário em planilhas;
  • Boas habilidades de comunicação;
  • Trabalho em equipe;
  • Habilidades excepcionais em organização e gestão de tempo.


Bolsa:

  • R$ 1.200,00 por mês
  • Vale-transporte
  • Horário: 9h as 16h (1h de intervalo)


Benefícios:

→ Seguro de vida;

→ Day off no aniversário ;

→ Chance real de efetivação!


Sobre nós:

A Egrégora é uma empresa especializada em processos de autorizações de residência e naturalização brasileira, com foco em excelência, organização e um ambiente leve e colaborativo.

title: Analista de Dados Pleno
description:
MISSÃO DO CARGO

Ser o elo entre dados e decisões, garantindo que as informações da empresa se transformem em conhecimento estratégico e ações concretas. A pessoa nesta posição será responsável por estruturar, tratar e traduzir dados complexos em análises claras, confiáveis e orientadas ao negócio, contribuindo para elevar a maturidade analítica da organização e apoiar times na tomada de decisão baseada em evidências.


RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Estruturar e tratar dados oriundos de múltiplas fontes, garantindo integridade, padronização e confiabilidade;
  • Construir consultas SQL e pipelines de dados para alimentar relatórios e dashboards;
  • Desenvolver análises exploratórias e diagnósticos para identificar causas, tendências e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Criar e manter painéis de visualização que comuniquem claramente indicadores e insights de negócio;
  • Apoiar diferentes áreas na tradução de necessidades em soluções analíticas e na definição de métricas e KPIs;
  • Promover a evolução da maturidade analítica e disseminar boas práticas de governança de dados;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com as equipes de processos e sistemas para estruturar dados e automatizar fluxos;
  • Manter documentação atualizada sobre origens de dados, lógicas de tratamento e regras de cálculo.


CONHECIMENTOS E HABILIDADES

description:
Marketing Designer Pleno

Arbitralis • Belo Horizonte / Remoto

A Arbitralis busca uma pessoa de marketing com olhar de produto e força visual — alguém organizado, crítico e que usa IA como parte natural do processo criativo e operacional.

  • Entender profundamente nosso ICP
  • Desenhar jornadas claras que orientem mensagens e iniciativas

  • Criar e operar nossos principais canais: LinkedIn, newsletter e blog
  • Produzir conteúdos que apoiem social selling e construção de autoridade

  • Criar peças, apresentações e layouts no Figma/Canva
  • Garantir consistência visual e narrativa em todos os pontos de contato

  • Construir automações e fluxos inteligentes com IA
  • Testar hipóteses, documentar processos e medir resultados

  • Contribuir com campanhas, parcerias, eventos e iniciativas de autoridade

  • 2 a 5 anos em Produto, UX/UI, Growth, Marketing ou áreas híbridas

  • Facilidade com ferramentas digitais e no-code
  • Uso real e frequente de IA no dia a dia

  • Experiência com automações (n8n, Make, Zapier)

  • Espaço para transformar IA em vantagem competitiva real
  • Crescimento rápido em uma operação nacional
  • Contato direto com founders e decisões estratégicas
  • Ambiente organizado, veloz e orientado a impacto

A Arbitralis é uma câmara de arbitragem digital que está redesenhando um mercado gigante e pouco explorado.

A arbitragem está presente em praticamente todas as relações contratuais, e o setor precisa de clareza, narrativa, design e conteúdo estratégico para crescer.

Estamos construindo um posicionamento forte, com tecnologia avançada, IA aplicada, velocidade de execução e uma visão clara sobre como transformar acesso à justiça no Brasil.

Se você gosta de ambientes inteligentes, de aprender rápido, de testar sem travar e de participar diretamente na construção da marca e do produto, aqui tem muito espaço.

title: Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations - SCM / Production Consultant
description:
Senior Dynamics 365 F&O Production & Supply Chain Consultant (Remote – Brazil)

Industry: Biotechnology

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Employment Type: Contract (Time & Materials - hourly)


About the Company

Join a global biotechnology leader transforming the future of life sciences through advanced research, sustainable manufacturing, and innovative digital technologies. As part of their large-scale operations expansion, the company is seeking a highly experienced Senior Dynamics 365 F&O Production & Supply Chain Management Consultant to strengthen their manufacturing and supply chain systems in preparation for global-scale D365 F&O roll out.


Role Overview

As the Senior D365 F&O SCM/Production Consultant , you will be the subject-matter expert for Production, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain modules. You will lead solution design, drive process optimization, and support global teams across complex, regulated environments. Your expertise will be critical in enhancing operational efficiency and ensuring the D365 platform supports end-to-end supply chain excellence.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, configuration, and optimization of Production , Supply Chain Management , Warehouse Management , and Manufacturing modules in D365 F&O.
  • Collaborate with operations, supply chain, and manufacturing leaders to translate business challenges into scalable technical solutions.
  • Drive full lifecycle implementations and continuous improvement initiatives across global sites.
  • Provide expert guidance in areas such as BOMs, Routes, Master Planning, MRP, Production Control, Inventory Management, Procurement, and Quality.
  • Run requirements workshops, create functional documentation, guide testing cycles, and support go-live and hypercare phases.
  • Mentor junior consultants and ensure adherence to best practices in a regulated biotech setting.
  • Support integrations with MES, LIMS, warehouse automation, and supply chain planning tools where applicable.


Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience with Dynamics AX and/or Dynamics 365 F&O focused on Production and Supply Chain modules.
  • Deep knowledge of manufacturing processes, supply chain workflows, and operational best practices.
  • Proven leadership in multi-phase D365 ERP implementations or transformation programmes.
  • Strong communication skills in English; Portuguese or Spanish advantageous.
  • Ability to operate independently in a remote-first environment.
  • Must reside in Brazil .


Nice to Have

  • Experience in biotech, pharmaceutical, or other GMP-regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Exposure to MES integration, WMS solutions, or advanced planning systems.
  • Familiarity with Power Platform, Azure DevOps, and cross-functional D365 capabilities.


What’s on Offer

  • 100% remote role based in Brazil.
  • Opportunity to influence global manufacturing and supply chain operations in a global D365 F&O roll-out.
  • Work with a mission-driven bio-tech innovator.


How to Apply

If you are a seasoned Production & Supply Chain expert with strong D365 F&O experience, we’d love to connect. Apply now and help shape the digital backbone supporting groundbreaking biotech advancements.

As part of their large-scale operations expansion, the company is seeking a highly experienced Senior Dynamics 365 F&O Production & Supply Chain Management Consultant to strengthen their manufacturing and supply chain systems in preparation for global-scale D365 F&O roll out.


Role Overview

As the Senior D365 F&O SCM/Production Consultant , you will be the subject-matter expert for Production, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain modules. You will lead solution design, drive process optimization, and support global teams across complex, regulated environments. Your expertise will be critical in enhancing operational efficiency and ensuring the D365 platform supports end-to-end supply chain excellence.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, configuration, and optimization of Production , Supply Chain Management , Warehouse Management , and Manufacturing modules in D365 F&O.
  • Collaborate with operations, supply chain, and manufacturing leaders to translate business challenges into scalable technical solutions.
  • Drive full lifecycle implementations and continuous improvement initiatives across global sites.
  • Provide expert guidance in areas such as BOMs, Routes, Master Planning, MRP, Production Control, Inventory Management, Procurement, and Quality.
  • Run requirements workshops, create functional documentation, guide testing cycles, and support go-live and hypercare phases.
  • Mentor junior consultants and ensure adherence to best practices in a regulated biotech setting.
  • Support integrations with MES, LIMS, warehouse automation, and supply chain planning tools where applicable.


Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience with Dynamics AX and/or Dynamics 365 F&O focused on Production and Supply Chain modules.
  • Deep knowledge of manufacturing processes, supply chain workflows, and operational best practices.
  • Proven leadership in multi-phase D365 ERP implementations or transformation programmes.
  • Strong communication skills in English; Portuguese or Spanish advantageous.
  • Ability to operate independently in a remote-first environment.
  • Must reside in Brazil .


Nice to Have

  • Experience in biotech, pharmaceutical, or other GMP-regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Exposure to MES integration, WMS solutions, or advanced planning systems.
  • Familiarity with Power Platform, Azure DevOps, and cross-functional D365 capabilities.


What’s on Offer

  • 100% remote role based in Brazil.
  • Opportunity to influence global manufacturing and supply chain operations in a global D365 F&O roll-out.
  • Work with a mission-driven bio-tech innovator.


How to Apply

If you are a seasoned Production & Supply Chain expert with strong D365 F&O experience, we’d love to connect. Apply now and help shape the digital backbone supporting groundbreaking biotech advancements.

title: Release Management Specialist
description:
Release Management Specialist | CI/CD, Software Development | Real-Time Financial Data Platform


*Please apply with CV written in English language


  • 2 days a month in office in Sao Paulo


Our client is hiring a hands-on Release Management Specialist with QA engineering experience to join a high-performance team building the next-gen, cloud-native market data platform that delivers real-time financial information to clients around the world.


This is not a coordination-only role, you’ll be actively involved in release planning, test execution, and CI/CD pipeline management. You’ll work closely with engineering leads, DevOps, product teams, and a senior UK-based Release Manager to deliver clean, reliable software into production environments. A deep understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and how to support it with repeatable, high-integrity release processes is essential.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Owning release planning, deployment and QA across agile squads
  • Writing and running tests with tools like Selenium, Cypress and Playwright
  • Tracking release readiness in Jira, including roadmaps and Zephyr
  • Managing CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Octopus, Jenkins or Azure DevOps
  • Supporting global product teams in Brazil, working UK hours with occasional evening releases
  • Collaborating daily with engineers, SREs and scrum masters


What we’re looking for:

  • Strong hands-on release and QA experience
  • Understanding of the full software development lifecycle
  • Exposure of C# or Python or Java
  • Experience testing and shipping code in fast-moving agile teams
  • Familiarity with infrastructure, deployment tools and Git-based workflows
  • Ability to work with legacy code and under-tested systems
  • Comfortable owning technical detail and solving blockers fast


If you’re interested in hearing more about this opportunity, please apply and we will be in touch to set up a call!

title: Shopify Developer
description:
Company Description

ECD Digital + Strategy is an ROI-driven, e-commerce digital marketing and ad agency that specializes in serving B2C e-commerce businesses. With a focus on driving positive and trackable ROI for our clients, our goal as an agency is to make our clients more profitable. We guarantee that all of our work will result in increased trackable revenue for our clients, positioning us as an integral and irreplaceable partner in their ongoing growth and competitive advantage.


Requirements


  • Bilingual or Native English Speaker
  • 4+ years of experience with shopify, liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and problem solving skills
  • A portfolio of work


Role Description


This is a full-time remote role for a Shopify Developer. As a Shopify Developer, you will be responsible for creating and maintaining custom Shopify themes, integrating third-party apps and extensions, optimizing website performance, and developing custom functionality using Shopify's APIs. Your day-to-day tasks will include collaborating with our design and marketing teams, implementing design mockups into Shopify themes, troubleshooting and solving website issues, and staying up-to-date with Shopify's latest updates and best practices.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Shopify theme development and customization
  • Experience with Liquid template language
  • HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills
  • Knowledge of responsive web design principles
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git)
  • Experience with Shopify Plus is a plus
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Experience in e-commerce or digital marketing is a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Web Development, or related field


What’s in it for you

  • The opportunity to lead 7-8 figure e-commerce brands to success through digital marketing efforts
  • The opportunity to collaborate with the marketing and creative teams on various projects
  • Remote work and flexible schedule
  • Competitive PTO and compensation


Next Steps:

Apply for the job! Answer the questions and submit your resume! We’ll review your application as quickly as we can and get back to you.

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)- LATAM
description:
About the Role


We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer (UX/UI) who excels at turning complex problems into intuitive, meaningful digital experiences. In this role, you’ll join one of our U.S.-based partner teams as an embedded designer, creating high-impact products for well-known brands across industries such as healthcare, finance, insurance, and enterprise digital platforms.


You should be a creative thinker with a user-centered mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams in fast-paced environments. This role requires end-to-end design capabilities — from research and strategy through wireframes, prototypes, and polished UI.

Who We’re Looking For


A designer who:


  • Thinks strategically and designs with intention
  • Empathizes deeply with users and advocates for their needs
  • Thrives in rapid, collaborative environments
  • Communicates clearly and confidently in English
  • Has experience working with large brands or complex digital products
  • Brings a portfolio that demonstrates strong UX thinking and refined UI execution
Qualifications & Experience


Required:


  • 7+ years of experience as a Product Designer, UX Designer, or similar
  • Strong portfolio with UX case studies (research, flows, prototypes, UI)
  • English C1/C2 — excellent communication & presentation skills
  • Expertise in Figma (design systems, prototyping, components)
  • Experience conducting research (interviews, surveys, usability testing)
  • Solid understanding of user-centered design principles and methodologies
  • Ability to define user flows, IA, and navigation for web/mobile products
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining design systems
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate with product managers, developers, and stakeholders
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail


Bonus (Nice to Have):

  • Experience with HTML / CSS / JavaScript (not required)
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG 2.x)
  • Experience designing dashboards, apps, or multi-platform interfaces
  • Understanding of SEO, content strategy, analytics
  • Experience working within agile environments


Responsibilities


  • Conduct user research (interviews, usability tests, surveys) to uncover behaviors, needs, and pain points
  • Analyze research findings and turn them into actionable insights
  • Create personas, journey maps, user flows, and IA
  • Design wireframes and interactive prototypes (low → high fidelity)
  • Collaborate with product managers, clients, and developers to define scope and goals
  • Lead ideation workshops and contribute innovative product ideas
  • Present design decisions with clarity and rationale
  • Iterate based on feedback from users, stakeholders, and engineering teams
  • Maintain design consistency through design systems and UI libraries
  • Stay current with design trends, tools, and best practices
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of design processes


What We Offer


  • Competitive USD contract rate
  • Work on high-impact digital products with established U.S. companies
  • PTO

In this role, you’ll join one of our U.S.-based partner teams as an embedded designer, creating high-impact products for well-known brands across industries such as healthcare, finance, insurance, and enterprise digital platforms.


You should be a creative thinker with a user-centered mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams in fast-paced environments. This role requires end-to-end design capabilities — from research and strategy through wireframes, prototypes, and polished UI.

Who We’re Looking For


A designer who:


  • Thinks strategically and designs with intention
  • Empathizes deeply with users and advocates for their needs
  • Thrives in rapid, collaborative environments
  • Communicates clearly and confidently in English
  • Has experience working with large brands or complex digital products
  • Brings a portfolio that demonstrates strong UX thinking and refined UI execution
Qualifications & Experience


Required:


  • 7+ years of experience as a Product Designer, UX Designer, or similar
  • Strong portfolio with UX case studies (research, flows, prototypes, UI)
  • English C1/C2 — excellent communication & presentation skills
  • Expertise in Figma (design systems, prototyping, components)
  • Experience conducting research (interviews, surveys, usability testing)
  • Solid understanding of user-centered design principles and methodologies
  • Ability to define user flows, IA, and navigation for web/mobile products
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining design systems
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate with product managers, developers, and stakeholders
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail


Bonus (Nice to Have):

  • Experience with HTML / CSS / JavaScript (not required)
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG 2.x)
  • Experience designing dashboards, apps, or multi-platform interfaces
  • Understanding of SEO, content strategy, analytics
  • Experience working within agile environments


Responsibilities


  • Conduct user research (interviews, usability tests, surveys) to uncover behaviors, needs, and pain points
  • Analyze research findings and turn them into actionable insights
  • Create personas, journey maps, user flows, and IA
  • Design wireframes and interactive prototypes (low → high fidelity)
  • Collaborate with product managers, clients, and developers to define scope and goals
  • Lead ideation workshops and contribute innovative product ideas
  • Present design decisions with clarity and rationale
  • Iterate based on feedback from users, stakeholders, and engineering teams
  • Maintain design consistency through design systems and UI libraries
  • Stay current with design trends, tools, and best practices
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of design processes


What We Offer


  • Competitive USD contract rate
  • Work on high-impact digital products with established U.S. companies
  • PTO

title: Especialista em segurança
description:
A Stone está com uma oportunidade em seu time de Segurança em Desenvolvimento (AppSec) na área de Segurança da Informação para trabalhar com foco em projetos de Inteligência Artificial, em especial interfaces conversacionais! Você gosta de buscar novos desafios e adquirir novos conhecimentos para acelerar o desenvolvimento de carreira? Se sim, venha fazer parte do nosso time de Segurança da Informação, como Analista de Segurança em Desenvolvimento Senior na Stone!

O time de AppSec tem como propósito garantir que os aplicativos sejam desenvolvidos, mantidos e utilizados de maneira segura e protegida contra ameaças cibernéticas. Buscamos evitar que nossos sistemas tenham vulnerabilidades que possam ser exploradas por criminosos cibernéticos, visando proteger dados sensíveis, a privacidade dos usuários e a integridade das aplicações.


Como é ser Analista de Segurança em Desenvolvimento Senior?


Dentre as atividades de trabalho esperadas, estão:


Estratégia, Colaboração e Arquitetura Segura em IA:

  • Ser o ponto focal de segurança, colaborando diretamente com times de engenharia em projetos de Inteligência Artificial.
  • Participar e conduzir ativamente revisões de arquitetura para sistemas baseados em IA, desde a concepção até a fase de produção.
  • Realizar threat modeling específico para identificar e mitigar vetores de ataque exclusivos de sistemas de IA.
  • Desenvolver e manter um programa de segurança, abrangendo atividades defensivas e ofensivas, para aplicações de Inteligência Artificial Generativa (GenAI).

Domínio de Riscos e Vulnerabilidades de Segurança em IA:

  • Possuir profundo conhecimento em riscos de segurança e privacidade específicos de IA, incluindo (mas não limitado a) o OWASP Top 10 for LLMs :
  • Prompt Injection e técnicas de jailbreak.
  • Insecure Output Handling e riscos de execução de código.
  • Data Poisoning em datasets de treino/fine-tuning.
  • Model Denial of Service e ataques de exaustão de recursos.
  • Vulnerabilidades na cadeia de suprimentos (Supply Chain) de modelos, dados e dependências.
  • Vazamento de Informações Sensíveis (Sensitive Information Disclosure).
  • Insecure Plugin Design e riscos associados a tool/function calling.
  • Excessive Agency em sistemas e agentes autônomos.

title: Product Manager 100% Remote Brazil
description:
Ardan Labs is a software engineering company specializing in training, staffing, and consulting firm specializing in Go, Rust, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform. With over 60 years of combined experience, our high-performance software engineering teams help companies solve technical and engineering problems, from filling skill gaps to tech stack performance optimization and architecture overhauls. 


Role Description

The Product Manager is responsible for driving the day-to-day management of one of teams in the blockchain space. The project partners with the leading protocols to build whatever on-chain interaction they require that may include custody, staking, and governance support. This role requires a combination of technical understanding, business acumen, and leadership skills to build new asset support, manage a backlog of features and maintenance improvements, and think strategically about scaling the way we work. 

Technical Skills:

  • Independently define the requirements and roadmap, collaborating closely with an agile scrum team on blockchain integrations.
  • Proactively research protocol integrations with emerging blockchains, developing on-chain solutions that drive value for protocol foundations and institutional investors.

Complexity and Impact of Work:

  • Lead the blockchain team in day-to-day operations and drive cross-team initiatives, ensuring alignment with project goals and ownership of your team and their focus area.
  • Work closely with sales, design, and engineering - set the pace, drive projects forward and unblock the team. Write high quality PRDs that are clearly written and easy to understand.

Organizational Knowledge:

  • Understand the requirements that span across departments including compliance, legal, and operations to ensure we’re building the right product or service and escalating the potential impact to the appropriate stakeholders and and your managers when appropriate. 

Communication and Influence:

  • Educate your scrum team on needs from external protocols teams.
  • Communicate the roadmap clearly and persuasively across stakeholders.
  • Adapt communication both internally and externally in an effective manner. Explain and convince others the need to adapt or change processes, policies, structures, and methods to deliver their goals.

You may be a fit for this role if you have:

  • You have 4-6 years of relevant product management experience. Experience with blockchain and web3 companies not required.
  • You have experience in driving and managing complex projects across multiple teams, demonstrating exceptional leadership and problem-solving skills.
  • You have a background in engineering, equipping you with the acumen to effectively collaborate with technical teams to solve problems.
  • Your empathy and adaptability not only complement others’ working styles but also embody our culture of curiosity, creativity, and shared understanding
  • You are autonomous, with the ability to make informed decisions that align with our strategic goals.
  • You are deeply invested in optimizing the end-user experience and leveraging it to create business value.
  • You have excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • You self describe as some combination of the following: creative, humble, ambitious, detail oriented, hard working, trustworthy, eager to learn, methodical, action oriented, and tenacious.

Bonus points if:

  • You have written your own smart contract or dApp.
  • Experience with finance, Crypto / Blockchain
  • You have a background in the world of finance.


Soft Skills 

  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects.
  • High engagement, self starter with a problem-solving mindset.

title: Engenheiro de Dados - Sênior
description:
Faça parte de uma das maiores empresas de serviços de TI do mundo! Aqui você transforma a sua carreira!


Por que entrar na TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, é por isso que vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado, cheia de oportunidades de melhoria, e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para o nosso sucesso em um ambiente colaborativo.


Estamos procurando por Engenheiro de Dados - Sênior , que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira, em modalidade CLT , híbrida / presencial, na cidade de Londrina-PR .



Nessa posição você irá:

O(A) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior é responsável por desenhar, construir e otimizar os pipelines de dados que servem como base para as iniciativas de Business Intelligence e Ciência de Dados da empresa. Este profissional atuará como uma referência técnica, garantindo que as soluções de dados sejam escaláveis, seguras e alinhadas às necessidades de negócio. Sua missão é transformar dados brutos em insights acionáveis, trabalhando em ambientes de alto volume e criticidade para suportar decisões estratégicas em públicos heterogêneos.


Principais Responsabilidades

● Desenvolver e manter pipelines de ETL/ELT robustos, utilizando ferramentas como Azure Data Factory, Synapse Pipelines e SSIS.

● Modelar dados em formatos relacionais e multidimensionais (Star Schema) para otimizar consultas e análises.

● Atuar como referência técnica para equipes de Ciência de Dados e Análise de Negócio, garantindo o acesso a dados de qualidade.

● Implementar e gerenciar soluções de Big Data em ambientes cloud, principalmente em Microsoft Azure (Data Lake, Synapse Analytics).

● Garantir a governança dos dados, aplicando padrões de desenvolvimento, qualidade e segurança.

● Automatizar processos de carga e replicação de dados, incluindo cenários de real-time.

● Colaborar na implementação de esteiras de DevOps (CI/CD) para projetos de Analytics e IA.


Formação e Experiência Mínima

  • Experiência mínima de 6 anos atuando diretamente com Engenharia de Dados ou Business Intelligence.
  • Estabilidade profissional com média de 2 anos nas últimas experiências registradas no currículo.
  • Formação superior completa e comprovada em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas. Não serão considerados cursos de curta duração ou predominantemente online.
  • Inglês em nível avançado para leitura técnica e comunicação.


Certificações

  • Obrigatório: Possuir pelo menos uma certificação técnica ativa relacionada à engenharia de dados.
  • Exemplo recomendado: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203).


Competências Técnicas (Hard Skills):

  • Sólida experiência em ambientes de dados heterogêneos, críticos e com alto volume.
  • Domínio de modelagem de dados multidimensional (star schema) e relacional.
  • SQL em nível avançado para consultas complexas e otimização de performance.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de ETL, preferencialmente SSIS, Azure Synapse Pipelines ou Azure Data Factory.
  • Conhecimento em ecossistemas Big Data (ex: Hadoop) e programação em Python para manipulação de dados.
  • Vivência com soluções de BI e visualização, especialmente Power BI.
  • Experiência com a stack de dados da Microsoft Azure: Azure SQL DB, Synapse Analytics (anteriormente SQL DW), Data Lake Store, e noções de Azure Machine Learning


Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

  • Comunicação clara e objetiva para interagir com áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Perfil proativo e engajado na resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Capacidade de organização, foco e gestão de prioridades.
  • Atitude colaborativa para trabalhar em equipes multidisciplinares.


Diferenciais (Nice to Have)

● Experiência com processos de carga e replicação de dados em tempo real (real-time).

● Conhecimento em outras plataformas de cloud (AWS, GCP).

● Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

title: Marketing Automation & Integration Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Marketing Automation & Integration Engineer to join our team.


Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.


What to expect on your journey with us:

  • A solid and innovative company with a strong market presence
  • A dynamic, diverse, and multicultural work environment
  • Leaders with deep market knowledge and strategic vision
  • Continuous learning and development


Team Function:

The team is responsible for architecting and maintaining scalable MarTech solutions, with a focus on:

- Data integration

- Customer journey orchestration

- Marketing automation

This team operates within the Data, Tech, and Operations tower of the Direct BU.


Role Description:

This role centers on the implementation and optimization of a MarTech data flow pattern involving Snowflake, Segment, Braze, and other SaaS platforms.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Design and maintain data pipelines between Snowflake, Segment CDP, Braze, and additional platforms
  • Implement real-time and batch data ingestion strategies
  • Manage customer event tracking and identity resolution within Segment
  • Orchestrate personalized marketing campaigns in Braze using dynamic segmentation and behavioral triggers
  • Ensure data integrity and feedback loops from Braze back into Snowflake via Segment
  • Automate data transformations and enrichment using scripting languages
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot integration issues across platforms


Requirements


  • 4 to 6 years of experience in IT environments with a strong focus on MarTech architecture.
  • Familiarity with insurance industry data and customer lifecycle models is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/IT, Data Science, Software Engineering.
  • Fluency in English


Software / Tools

  • Segment CDP
  • Braze
  • Snowflake
  • Scripting Languages (Python / JS)


Other Critical Skills

  • Reverse ETL
  • Data Orchestration Platforms
  • Customer Data Schema Design
  • Consent & Preference Management
  • Data modeling and ETL/ELT Pipeline
  • API Integrations / Webhooks
  • Customer journey mapping and automation logic


Benefits


This position comes with competitive compensation and benefits package:

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Career development and training opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
  • Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally reknowned group
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Pension Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Training & Development

title: Cloud Operations Lead
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Cloud Operations Lead com sólida experiência em AWS e vivência prática em operações e sustentação de ambientes críticos . Este(a) profissional será responsável por liderar tecnicamente o time de sustentação Cloud, garantindo estabilidade, performance e governança dos ambientes em nuvem.

Além de atuar como referência técnica, será o elo entre as áreas de operação, engenharia e gestão, apoiando na resolução de incidentes complexos, na implementação de melhorias contínuas e na disseminação das melhores práticas de ITIL e Cloud Operations .


Papéis e Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente o time de sustentação Cloud, atuando como referência em AWS;
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes de alta complexidade, garantindo a restauração rápida dos serviços;
  • Apoiar o Service Manager e o time de Suporte N2/N3 em ações corretivas e preventivas;
  • Implementar melhorias de automação, observabilidade e performance em ambientes AWS;
  • Garantir a aplicação das práticas ITIL (Gestão de Incidentes, Mudanças e Problemas);
  • Apoiar na criação de playbooks, runbooks e padrões operacionais para o time;
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e operacionais com clientes e áreas internas;
  • Atuar na governança de custos e eficiência operacional dos ambientes;
  • Promover a cultura de melhoria contínua e excelência técnica dentro da equipe.


Qualificações Essenciais:

  • Conhecimento em ITIL (Gestão de Incidentes, Problemas, Mudanças e SLAs);
  • Experiência sólida com AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, Lambda, VPC, etc.);
  • Vivência prática em ambientes de sustentação e operações Cloud;
  • Experiência com automação e infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation, ou similares);
  • Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade (CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus, ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em Linux/Windows Server, redes e segurança em Cloud;
  • Experiência em pipeline CI/CD e ferramentas como GitHub Actions ou AWS CodePipeline.
  • Inglês avançado


Qualificações Desejáveis:

  • Certificações AWS (Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator ou DevOps Engineer);
  • Experiência prévia como Tech Lead ou referência técnica em times de Sustentação/AMS;
  • Experiência com FinOps e otimização de custos em Cloud;
  • Conhecimento adicional em Azure ou GCP será considerado um diferencial.

description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.

♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Mapear todos os bancos e tabelas com campos relacionados ao CNPJ.

Ajustar schemas, tipos de dados, índices e constraints conforme o novo padrão.

Garantir consistência entre ambientes (desenvolvimento, teste, produção).

Apoiar desenvolvedores e engenheiros de dados na execução de scripts de atualização.

Validar e otimizar consultas SQL impactadas pela mudança.

Gerenciar migrações, backups e restores durante o processo de alteração.

Garantir a segurança e a governança de acesso aos bancos de dados.

Habilidades e Requisitos

- Criptografia de Dados

- ADMINISTRACAO DE BANCO DE DADOS: SQL SERVER, ORACLE SQL

- BANCO DE DADOS: ORACLE SQL DEVELOPER, MONGODB

- CRIACAO DE INDICES

- ARQUITETURAS PARALELAS E DISTRIBUIDAS

- ANALISE DE PERFORMANCE E TUNING

- ADMINISTRACAO DE BANCO DE DADOS (DBA)

- SQL SERVER ALWAYS ON

- CONTROLE DE VERSIONAMENTO (GIT / GITHUB / GITLAB)

- APIS E SCRIPTS (PYTHON, SHELL, POWERSHELL)

- AJUSTE DE STORED PROCEDURES

- DATA MASKING

- DATABASE MIRRORING

- AJUSTES EM TRIGGERS

- PARTICIONAMENTO DE DADOS

- AMBIENTES DE DESENVOLVIMENTO INTEGRADOS

- CONSTRAINTS

- LOG S

title: Analista de Fechamento Mensal Sr
description:
Desafio:

Garantir a execução oportuna e correta das atividades contábeis e controles de processos relacionados, identificando áreas de melhoria e processos a serem automatizados de acordo com uma abordagem orientada a dados. A equipe é composta por 220 colaboradores distribuídos em diferentes países: EUA, México, Colômbia, Chile, Brasil e Itália.


Atividades:

  • Gerenciar os registros contábeis dos processos de RTR (Contabilidade Bancária, Ativo Fixo, Folha de Pagamento, Margens, Derivativos, outras atividades), comparando-os com a documentação de suporte e as expectativas das áreas da empresa;
  • Gerenciar o correto funcionamento do processamento das transações contábeis terceirizadas por meio de BPO;
  • Gerenciar as atividades de fechamento contábil para fins de entrada de dados nos sistemas de consolidação;
  • Propor e desenvolver iniciativas de automação e/ou eficiência para novos processos e sistemas, inclusive por meio da coordenação de consultorias e de discussão contínua com as unidades administrativas internacionais do grupo;
  • Manter um processo de controle interno adequado nos processos rotineiros de contabilidade de transações e, em particular, nas atividades de fechamento contábil;
  • Garantir uma resposta eficiente e de qualidade às exigências de informação contábil dos stakeholders internos e externos, bem como de órgãos reguladores externos ao grupo;
  • Participar de projetos globais voltados à digitalização e robotização das operações, garantindo a conformidade com o modelo global de processos.


Requisitos:

  • Espanhol avançado;
  • Experiência com SAP;
  • Conhecimento do pacote Office;

title: Analista de Fechamento Mensal Sr
description:
Desafio:

Garantir a execução oportuna e correta das atividades contábeis e controles de processos relacionados, identificando áreas de melhoria e processos a serem automatizados de acordo com uma abordagem orientada a dados. A equipe é composta por 220 colaboradores distribuídos em diferentes países: EUA, México, Colômbia, Chile, Brasil e Itália.


Atividades:

  • Gerenciar os registros contábeis dos processos de RTR (Contabilidade Bancária, Ativo Fixo, Folha de Pagamento, Margens, Derivativos, outras atividades), comparando-os com a documentação de suporte e as expectativas das áreas da empresa;
  • Gerenciar o correto funcionamento do processamento das transações contábeis terceirizadas por meio de BPO;
  • Gerenciar as atividades de fechamento contábil para fins de entrada de dados nos sistemas de consolidação;
  • Propor e desenvolver iniciativas de automação e/ou eficiência para novos processos e sistemas, inclusive por meio da coordenação de consultorias e de discussão contínua com as unidades administrativas internacionais do grupo;
  • Manter um processo de controle interno adequado nos processos rotineiros de contabilidade de transações e, em particular, nas atividades de fechamento contábil;
  • Garantir uma resposta eficiente e de qualidade às exigências de informação contábil dos stakeholders internos e externos, bem como de órgãos reguladores externos ao grupo;
  • Participar de projetos globais voltados à digitalização e robotização das operações, garantindo a conformidade com o modelo global de processos.

description:

Sobre o Cargo: Especialista Salesforce


Responsabilidades:

Perfil de liderança

Desenvolver soluções customizadas na plataforma Salesforce utilizando Apex, LWC (Lightning Web Components), Visualforce e triggers.

Criar automações avançadas, componentes reutilizáveis e testes unitários com alta cobertura.

Domínio de todas as etapas do ciclo no Salesforce

Experiência prévia em projetos Salesforce (atuando como desenvolvedor).

Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e em squads multidisciplinares.

Experiência prática com integrações complexas e grandes volumes de dados.


Desejável experiência em projetos de implementação de soluções escaláveis em empresas de médio e grande porte.



Modelo de trabalho:

100% remoto

Benefícios:

title: Sales Intern (Adtech - US Visa Sponsored)
description:
Location: Remote

Employment Type: Internship


About Us

Orange Storm is a venture-backed AdTech and AI SaaS company with dual headquarters in California, USA and Barcelona, Spain. We provide an integrated ecosystem—including a DSP, SSP, Creative Studio, and AI-driven analytics platform—to help publishers and advertisers drive higher revenue and smarter decisions.

Our global, diverse team is our greatest asset. With a culture rooted in trust, ownership, and continuous learning, we empower talent to grow, experiment, and deliver real-world impact. We are proud of our collaborative spirit, agile execution, and commitment to building scalable, high-performance technologies that adapt to the ever-evolving AdTech landscape.


Role Overview:

We are seeking a versatile and experienced (Job Title) to lead our (scope). This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced global environment and can (expectation).


Key Responsibilities:

  • Research, identify, and approach potential advertisers, brands, and media agencies  in Spain and wider European markets.
  • Assist with lead generation, client outreach, proposal preparation, and follow-ups.
  • Help prepare tailored media solutions, sales presentations, and case studies.
  • Conduct market and competitive research to support the sales strategy.
  • Keep CRM tools updated with prospect and client interactions.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless client onboarding and support.


Requirements:

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Marketing, Business, Communication, or related fields .
  • Native or fluent in Spanish , with strong proficiency in English .
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated, well-organized, and capable of working remotely.
  • A keen interest in digital advertising, programmatic media, or marketing technology .


Compensation & Benefits:

  • A monthly allowance to cover basic expenses (e.g., meals, internet) .
  • Performance-based bonuses  for successful client engagements and deals.
  • Eligible for US relocation and visa sponsorship upon internship completion
  • Annual Leave: 20 working days paid leave per year (pro-rated) + local public holidays
  • Remote Work: Fully remote with reasonable overlap hours; occasional travel budget if needed
  • And many more!


Orange Storm is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity at all levels of the organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these factors.


We truly appreciate the time and effort every candidate puts into applying to Orange Storm. While we carefully review each application, due to the high volume of interest we receive, we’re unfortunately unable to respond to every individual submission. If your profile aligns with the role and we decide to move forward, a member of our team will reach out to you directly. We thank you in advance for your understanding and for considering a career with us.

description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!



Vaga: Analista Processos em TI

Jornada de Trabalho: De Segunda à Sexta-feira - Home Office

Horário de Trabalho: 08:00 às 17:00



Descrição Atividades:


  • Serviços de gestão de processos;
  • Acompanhar, atualizar e diligenciar Planners e mesas de atendimento indicadas pelo gestor do serviço;
  • Resolver chamados conforme atribuição na ferramenta ITSM;
  • Fornecer informações sobre o serviço a técnicos e usuários, sob demanda dos mesmos, via Teams;
  • Realizar análise crítica dos indicadores apurados, conforme definição pelo Gestor do Serviço;
  • Mensalmente, em data a ser alinhada com o Gestor do Serviço;
  • Preparar e convocar reunião; elaborar e divulgar ata;
  • Conduzir ou participar de reunião;
  • Administrar Catálogo de Ofertas de TIC;
  • Registrar Problemas em ferramenta de ITSM;
  • Diligenciar tratamento de Problemas;
  • Elaborar plano de ação, gerir plano de ação e atuar em plano de ação;


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Graduação completa em Administração, Engenharia de Produção ou Tecnologia da Informação e MBA ou pós graduação completa em Gestão da Qualidade, Gestão de Processos ou equivalente.
  • Exigido: CERTIFICAÇÃO: ITIL V4 - Fundamentos
  • Governança de TI Básico
  • COBIT Básico
  • Banco de Dados (Incluindo SQL) - Intermediário
  • Excel - Avançado
  • Power BI - Básico
  • Gestão de Projetos - Básico
  • Metodologias Ágeis - Básico


O que te oferecemos:


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: Analista de processos de sistemas
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!



Vaga: Analista Processos em TI

Jornada de Trabalho: De Segunda à Sexta-feira - Home Office

Horário de Trabalho: 08:00 às 17:00



Descrição Atividades:


  • Serviços de gestão de processos;
  • Acompanhar, atualizar e diligenciar Planners e mesas de atendimento indicadas pelo gestor do serviço;
  • Resolver chamados conforme atribuição na ferramenta ITSM;
  • Fornecer informações sobre o serviço a técnicos e usuários, sob demanda dos mesmos, via Teams;
  • Realizar análise crítica dos indicadores apurados, conforme definição pelo Gestor do Serviço;
  • Mensalmente, em data a ser alinhada com o Gestor do Serviço;
  • Preparar e convocar reunião; elaborar e divulgar ata;
  • Conduzir ou participar de reunião;
  • Administrar Catálogo de Ofertas de TIC;
  • Registrar Problemas em ferramenta de ITSM;
  • Diligenciar tratamento de Problemas;
  • Elaborar plano de ação, gerir plano de ação e atuar em plano de ação;


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Graduação completa em Administração, Engenharia de Produção ou Tecnologia da Informação e MBA ou pós graduação completa em Gestão da Qualidade, Gestão de Processos ou equivalente.
  • Exigido: CERTIFICAÇÃO: ITIL V4 - Fundamentos
  • Governança de TI Básico
  • COBIT Básico
  • Banco de Dados (Incluindo SQL) - Intermediário
  • Excel - Avançado
  • Power BI - Básico
  • Gestão de Projetos - Básico
  • Metodologias Ágeis - Básico


O que te oferecemos:


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: Desenvolvedor(a) de Software Backend SR
description:
Sobre o BS2

Somos um banco 100% digital e focado em empresas, com atendimento humanizado e soluções sob medida para cada cliente - afinal, nenhum negócio é igual ao outro. Essa lógica também se aplica à nossa cultura: temos um DNA inovador que instiga todo o nosso time a se reinventar constantemente. Por aqui, nossos colaboradores (os bessers) podem contar com um ambiente que impulsiona o crescimento da carreira e traz a oportunidade de lidar com os desafios do mercado financeiro com quem mais entende do assunto.


A área tem o foco em crédito PJ, com produtos voltados para capital de giro e diversas garantias (FGI, Pronampe, antecipação de recebíveis, notas promissórias).


Principais responsabilidades

  • Participar de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento: concepção, codificação, testes, implantação e sustentação.
  • Atuação com alto volume de transações e demandas regulatórias do mercado financeiro.
  • Atuar em projetos fim a fim, com forte interação com áreas de negócio e produto.
  • Resolver problemas em produção, com autonomia e visão crítica.
  • Trabalhar em squads multidisciplinares, com líderes técnicos e product owners.


Principais Tecnologias:

  • Linguagem principal: C# (.NET 6, 7 ou 8)
  • Angular – conhecimento é diferencial, não eliminatório.
  • Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) – conhecimento é diferencial, não eliminatório.
  • Arquitetura: Microsserviços
  • Banco de dados: SQL e NoSQL (ex: BigQuery)
  • Ferramentas de DevOps: Esteiras automatizadas, acompanhamento com SREs
  • Containers: Kubernetes (diferencial)


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida como desenvolvedor(a) sênior, com entregas completas de projetos.
  • Capacidade de comunicação com áreas de negócio e entendimento de regras.
  • Vivência com resolução de problemas em produção.
  • Perfil generalista, com visão ampla do processo de desenvolvimento.
  • Desejável: experiência no mercado financeiro.


Modelo de Trabalho:

Remoto, com preferência para candidatos de São Paulo ou Belo Horizonte.


Nossos benefícios:

️ Vale refeição no valor de R$ 1.003,48 ao mês;

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js, AWS, PHP)
description:
Role: Senior Full Stack Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Hours: US Time

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Location: 100% Remote


We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Backend Focused) to design, develop, and scale backend systems and APIs using Node.js, TypeScript, PHP, and AWS . You’ll collaborate across teams to ensure our platform is reliable, secure, and future-ready.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and build scalable backend services and APIs.
  • Maintain and enhance system performance and security.
  • Integrate third-party systems and ensure seamless front-end interaction.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams.


Required Skills:

  • 5+ years in full stack or backend development.
  • Strong in Node.js, TypeScript/JavaScript, PHP , and AWS/serverless .
  • Experience with relational + NoSQL databases .
  • Knowledge of microservices, Kubernetes , and security best practices.

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with legacy systems, Agile, IaC tools, and React.
  • Exposure to multi-cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) environments.

title: Internal Communications Partner - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the Role


The Internal Communications Partner will be responsible for crafting and executing compelling storytelling campaigns that amplify organizational culture, celebrate achievements, and strengthen employee engagement across multiple communication channels.


Key Responsibilities:


- Designing and executing storytelling campaigns that bring values, achievements, and culture to life.

- Curating and writing internal content that celebrates milestones, award wins, and people stories across newsletters, Slack, and internal portals.

- Partnering with designers to turn stories into visually engaging narratives including videos, graphics, and reels.

- Collaborating with Communications Partners to align all messaging to company tone, voice, and strategic priorities.

- Keeping employer branding platforms updated with accurate information, awards, and photos.


Requirements:


- Experience: 4-6 years in internal communications, employer branding, or storytelling within global or distributed organizations

- Campaign Management: Proven success managing multi-channel campaigns

- Collaboration: Experience working with internal teams on brand or engagement initiatives

- Tools: Knowledge of engagement and analytics tools (Mailchimp, Glassdoor Employer Center, Slack, Google Workspace, Figma/Canva) is a plus

- Industry Experience: Tech industry experience is a plus

- Language: Advanced level of English



Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Product Manager - E-commerce & Analytics (Remote, Japanese Essential)
description:
Your Rare Combination of Skills Could Transform Japan Travel


Most ECommerce Product Managers understand data. Some speak Japanese. Almost none have both.


If you're that rare person who can analyze a conversion funnel in GA4 and negotiate with Japanese rail partners in their language, keep reading.


The Reality Check (Read This First)


This role is NOT for you if:

  • Your Japanese is conversational but not business-level
  • Your PM experience is in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or physical products
  • You've never optimized an e-commerce checkout flow
  • You think GA4 is "just another analytics tool"
  • You prefer project management to product strategy


This role IS for you if:

  • You can run a business meeting in Japanese (not just order dinner)
  • You've spent years obsessing over why customers abandon carts
  • You know the difference between bounce rate and exit rate without Googling
  • You've built conversion funnels, not just analyzed them
  • You understand Japanese business culture (consensus-building, relationship-first communication)


What You'll Actually Do

Week 1-3: Become Our Detective

  • Dive into our GA4 setup and immediately spot what's broken
  • Interview customers who bought passes and those who didn't
  • Map every click from Google search to booking confirmation
  • Present findings that make us uncomfortable (in a good way)


Month 2-3: Fix What's Bleeding

  • Our conversion rate is 2%. Industry standard is 3-4%. Find the leaks.
  • Work with our Polish dev team to implement quick wins
  • Set up proper tracking so we stop flying blind
  • Run your first A/B test and actually know if it worked


Month 4-6: Build the Future

  • Achieve Product-Market fit for JapanDen.com through user research and behavioral analysis
  • Design the user journey for JapanDen.com (our content platform)
  • Launch point-to-point ticket sales (our 2-3x revenue opportunity)
  • Travel to Japan, sit with rail company partners, negotiate in Japanese
  • Become the person both our UK team and Japanese suppliers trust


Your Background

Must Have (Non-Negotiable):

  • Business-level Japanese - You've used it professionally, not just studied it
  • 3-5 years as a Product Manager in consumer e-commerce (D2C or B2C)
  • Hands-on GA4 experience - Custom events, conversion tracking, cohort analysis
  • Proven conversion optimization - You can tell us percentage improvements you've driven
  • E-commerce fundamentals - Product pages, checkout flows, cart abandonment strategies
  • Product-Market fit expertise - User research, market analysis, and translating customer behavior into product strategy


Nice to Have:

  • Experience in travel/tourism/hospitality
  • Technical background (can write basic SQL, understand APIs)
  • Living in a timezone within 5 hours of UK (but not required)
  • Experience working with Asian business partners


Don't Need:

  • CS degree or coding skills
  • Previous team management experience
  • Design skills (we have designers)


Why This Isn't Another Corporate PM Role

The Good:

  • Autonomy - You'll own the product roadmap, not execute someone else's vision
  • Impact - Your work affects millions of Japan travelers directly
  • Growth - We're profitable and expanding, not fighting for runway
  • Culture - 15 people globally, no corporate bureaucracy
  • Flexibility - Truly remote, work your hours, judge by output not activity


The Challenging:

  • You'll be the analytics expert - Our current PM doesn't use GA4, you'll need to lead here
  • Small team - No PM team to learn from, you'll need to be self-directed
  • Multiple platforms - JRPass.com (established) and JapanDen.com (startup mode)
  • Cultural bridge - Japanese partners expect relationship-building, UK team wants data and speed


The Reality:

  • You'll work with developers in Poland (4 people)

title: Staff ML Engineer
description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role

We are looking for our first Staff Machine Learning Engineer to establish and lead our machine learning initiatives. This is a critical, foundational role where you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of data science and ML at Niche. You will be responsible for identifying high-impact opportunities, designing, building, and deploying machine learning models that directly drive business growth and enhance user experience across our platform.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on practitioner who is passionate about translating business challenges into data-driven solutions. You build, you code, you ship, you measure. You have a proven history of deploying ML models into production environments that have delivered tangible results. You possess the experience and desire to mentor future ML hires and establish best practices as our capabilities grow.


What You Will Do

  • Identify & Prioritize: Collaborate closely with product, engineering, data analytics, and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize the most impactful ML opportunities that align with Niche’s strategic goals. Our first area of focus is our Recommendations, which includes matching students with the right schools
  • Design & Build: Lead the end-to-end development of machine learning models – from data collection and feature engineering to algorithm selection, training, tuning, and validation. This is a hands-on coding role
  • Deploy & Integrate: Develop production-grade code and systems to deploy, serve, and monitor ML models at scale, ensuring reliability and performance. Integrate models effectively into Niche’s products and internal systems
  • Measure & Iterate: Define key performance metrics, establish robust monitoring frameworks, analyze model performance in production, and drive continuous improvement through iteration and experimentation
  • Champion & Evangelize: Clearly communicate complex ML concepts, model behaviors, and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Champion the use of machine learning & data science across the organization
  • Lead & Mentor: Establish ML development best practices, coding standards, and documentation. As the function grows you will guide and mentor other ML engineers
  • Innovate: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in machine learning, data science, and MLOps, evaluating and potentially adopting new technologies and techniques relevant to Niche


First Year Plan

During the 1st Month:

  • Learn about Niche by meeting with various team members to learn more about our company through our Onboarding meetings
  • Deep-dive into Niche’s platform, data architecture, and recommendation systems
  • Align with product and engineering teams on business goals and ML impact areas
  • Begin shaping a roadmap for high-impact ML opportunities

Within 3 Months:

  • Deploy your first machine learning model into production with robustmonitoring and
  • feedback loops
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to define success metrics andintegration
  • strategies
  • Establish early ML development workflows, documentation, andperformance monitoring
  • Contribute production-ready code for feature engineering and modelexperimentation

Within 6 Months:

  • Drive measurable improvements through experimentation and model iteration
  • Introduce scalable MLOps practices to support deployment, retraining, and governance
  • Serve as a mentor and set engineering best practices for a growing ML function

Within 12 Months:

  • Lead ML efforts across multiple product areas, driving business impact at scale
  • Influence company-wide strategy through technical leadership and ML evangelism
  • Develop internal tooling, reusable frameworks, and scalable ML systems
  • Help grow the team through hiring, mentorship, and a culture of innovation


What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in software development or data science, with at least 5+ years specifically focused on building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
  • Proven Impact: Demonstrable track record of successfully shipping multiple machine learning models that resulted in measurable business growth (e.g., increased user engagement, conversion rates, operational efficiency, revenue). You can clearly articulate the business problem, the ML solution, and the quantitative impact achieved
  • Technical Depth (Hands-On):
  • Expertise in Python and common ML libraries/frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, XGBoost)
  • Deep understanding of core ML concepts (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, recommendation systems, NLP, time series analysis, experimentation, model evaluation)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and data processing tools (e.g., Pandas, Spark)
  • Experience with ML deployment patterns and MLOps principles (e.g., model serving, monitoring, CI/CD for ML, feature stores)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is essential
  • Business Acumen: Strong ability to understand business needs, translate them into well-defined ML problems, and connect technical work back to strategic objectives. You prioritize work based on potential business impact
  • Leadership Experience: Experience or a strong aptitude for leading technical projects, defining technical direction, and mentoring others. Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Education: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, OR equivalent practical experience demonstrating deep expertise in machine learning


Bonus Points

  • Experience building ML capabilities from the ground up
  • Experience with recommendation systems, search ranking algorithms, or NLP applied to user-generated content
  • Experience in the EdTech or consumer-facing platform space
  • Familiarity with golang, express, Postgres, Snowflake, DBT, and Tableau
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or publications in relevant conferences/journals


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role

We are looking for our first Staff Machine Learning Engineer to establish and lead our machine learning initiatives. This is a critical, foundational role where you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of data science and ML at Niche. You will be responsible for identifying high-impact opportunities, designing, building, and deploying machine learning models that directly drive business growth and enhance user experience across our platform.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on practitioner who is passionate about translating business challenges into data-driven solutions. You build, you code, you ship, you measure. You have a proven history of deploying ML models into production environments that have delivered tangible results. You possess the experience and desire to mentor future ML hires and establish best practices as our capabilities grow.


What You Will Do

  • Identify & Prioritize: Collaborate closely with product, engineering, data analytics, and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize the most impactful ML opportunities that align with Niche’s strategic goals. Our first area of focus is our Recommendations, which includes matching students with the right schools
  • Design & Build: Lead the end-to-end development of machine learning models – from data collection and feature engineering to algorithm selection, training, tuning, and validation. This is a hands-on coding role
  • Deploy & Integrate: Develop production-grade code and systems to deploy, serve, and monitor ML models at scale, ensuring reliability and performance. Integrate models effectively into Niche’s products and internal systems
  • Measure & Iterate: Define key performance metrics, establish robust monitoring frameworks, analyze model performance in production, and drive continuous improvement through iteration and experimentation
  • Champion & Evangelize: Clearly communicate complex ML concepts, model behaviors, and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Champion the use of machine learning & data science across the organization
  • Lead & Mentor: Establish ML development best practices, coding standards, and documentation. As the function grows you will guide and mentor other ML engineers
  • Innovate: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in machine learning, data science, and MLOps, evaluating and potentially adopting new technologies and techniques relevant to Niche


First Year Plan

During the 1st Month:

  • Learn about Niche by meeting with various team members to learn more about our company through our Onboarding meetings
  • Deep-dive into Niche’s platform, data architecture, and recommendation systems
  • Align with product and engineering teams on business goals and ML impact areas
  • Begin shaping a roadmap for high-impact ML opportunities

Within 3 Months:

  • Deploy your first machine learning model into production with robustmonitoring and
  • feedback loops
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to define success metrics andintegration
  • strategies
  • Establish early ML development workflows, documentation, andperformance monitoring
  • Contribute production-ready code for feature engineering and modelexperimentation

Within 6 Months:

  • Drive measurable improvements through experimentation and model iteration
  • Introduce scalable MLOps practices to support deployment, retraining, and governance
  • Serve as a mentor and set engineering best practices for a growing ML function

Within 12 Months:

  • Lead ML efforts across multiple product areas, driving business impact at scale
  • Influence company-wide strategy through technical leadership and ML evangelism
  • Develop internal tooling, reusable frameworks, and scalable ML systems
  • Help grow the team through hiring, mentorship, and a culture of innovation


What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in software development or data science, with at least 5+ years specifically focused on building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
  • Proven Impact: Demonstrable track record of successfully shipping multiple machine learning models that resulted in measurable business growth (e.g., increased user engagement, conversion rates, operational efficiency, revenue). You can clearly articulate the business problem, the ML solution, and the quantitative impact achieved
  • Technical Depth (Hands-On):
  • Expertise in Python and common ML libraries/frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, XGBoost)
  • Deep understanding of core ML concepts (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, recommendation systems, NLP, time series analysis, experimentation, model evaluation)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and data processing tools (e.g., Pandas, Spark)
  • Experience with ML deployment patterns and MLOps principles (e.g., model serving, monitoring, CI/CD for ML, feature stores)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is essential
  • Business Acumen: Strong ability to understand business needs, translate them into well-defined ML problems, and connect technical work back to strategic objectives. You prioritize work based on potential business impact
  • Leadership Experience: Experience or a strong aptitude for leading technical projects, defining technical direction, and mentoring others. Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Education: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, OR equivalent practical experience demonstrating deep expertise in machine learning


Bonus Points

  • Experience building ML capabilities from the ground up
  • Experience with recommendation systems, search ranking algorithms, or NLP applied to user-generated content
  • Experience in the EdTech or consumer-facing platform space
  • Familiarity with golang, express, Postgres, Snowflake, DBT, and Tableau
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or publications in relevant conferences/journals


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Consultor SOC Pleno
description:
Oportunidade:

Consultor SOC Pleno, com experiência em administração de SIEM (Wazuh, IBM QRadar, Splunk e Microsoft Sentinel) e conhecimento em implementação.

Experiências Obrigatórias:

  • Criação de Conectores/log Source;
  • Criação de Regras e KPIs em SIEM;
  • Elaboração de documentação e Arquitetura da solução;
  • Participação em Troubleshooting do Ambiente e Regras;
  • Prestar Auxílio para Equipes Operacionais (SOC);

  • Acompanhamento de consumo de recursos;
  • Inglês intermediário capaz de realizar reunião com o suporte e/ou fornecedores.

Diferenciais Desejados

  • Participação de troubleshooting
  • Vivência com Azure/AWS/GCP;
  • Certificações e Treinamentos

Estamos em busca de profissionais que estejam por dentro das melhores tecnologias.

Gostamos de pessoas curiosas, que tenham senso de dono, facilidade em resolver problemas, autonomia e boa comunicação.

title: Ecommerce Growth Marketing Paid Media Specialist
description:
We are a DTC Ecommerce Growth Consulting & Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses attract, engage, and convert their ideal audience.

Our Mission: to help DTC ecommerce companies grow holistically

Our Vision: We imagine a world where service businesses never have to worry about meeting revenue goals, attracting consistent quality customers, retaining customers, or maintaining and growing their overall online presence.


Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated

- Pay close attention to detail 

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator

- Confidence and determination to achieve our vision.


Who We Are Looking For:


We are looking for an ecommerce Paid Media Specialist who has experience managing large ad budgets across Meta and Google primarily. (Ideally over 1 million dollars USD per month). Additionally, if you experience using MTAs such as NorthBeam, incrementality testing tools, and MMM tools for data validation that is a major plus.


The candidate selected for this role would come in and manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts for US based ecommerce brands. We have a lot of high-profile ecommerce clients that we work with and we are looking for a seasoned Paid Media Specialist who can produce high quality results for our clients.


The right candidate will be task-oriented, analytical, and willing to keep the team and ad accounts on pace to make sure we are meeting or exceeding client expectations. A self-starter who can see problems and go to work fixing them and not be just an order taker. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands.


Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ads.


Responsibilities

  • Manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands
  • Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok
  • Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients
  • Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of
  • Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps
  • Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness
  • Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses)
  • Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred
  • Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands
  • Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients
  • Autonomous worker with an analytical mind
  • Portfolio of work, results, or case studies
  • You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not.
  • You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that.


Compensation:

  • $2000 - $7000 USD per month
